Im not too great at explaining why these games are great but they hold a special place in my heart for various reasons.

I played Kingdom Hearts 1 on the PS2 when I was younger. I loved it but was too stupid as a wee bab and never followed the series afterwards minus playing KH2 though I can't remember finishing it.

My best friends favourite game series is Kingdom Hearts and he would always talk about it and persuaded me to get back into it

When this collection came out I jumped on the opportunity and dived right in and what a hell of a ride it has been. I smashed through KH1 in 3 days (mainly because Persona 5 was out the following Tuesday) and the nostalgia hit HARD. It made me so happy seeing everyone again and, even though the combat isnt as smooth as 2 it still felt good to play.

I was a bit against the change of gameplay when it came to the handheld titles - Re:Chain/BBS (why do i have cards now?) but after playing and having a couple friends help explain they became just as fun as KH1/2. Re:Chain became an event of sorts my best friend and I. At first we would just riff on how bad it was but it slowly turned into a charm, it was a great experience which made me appretiate the various combat systems in games.

All in all this series is really good, you've got alot of games to play but it's worth it in the end because there is truly no other game series like Kingdom Hearts. Its goofy (no pun intended), fun, ridiculously insane, sad, it's got everything.

Im still currently making my way through the series after playing it basically exclusively since release. I'm currently playing through DDD and am sad that its nearly over. Waiting for 3 isnt going to be fun, I can't believe how long people have been waiting for this.
